summary: @servicetitan/forge preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime as a zip from GitHub releases, extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary to a temp directory, chmod 0755s it, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle using string-array rotation and a coded integer/string dictionary. `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex-suffixed identifiers, per-function string-lookup maps). The advertised purpose of the package is a React UI component library, which has no need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or execute an obfuscated bundle under it. Fetching a foreign runtime and using it to run an opaque payload at `npm install` time causes attacker-controlled code — whatever `math_init.js` decodes to — to execute on the installer's host outside the visibility of Node-based tooling and reviewers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
